entries.desc: Read Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md and confirm it presents an explicit authority/local mode matrix that separates local/off, shadow, and enforce/receipt-backed modes, including what each mode can and cannot prove about authority and lifecycle state.

evidence.command: rg -n 'Authority Modes And Evidence Chains|\| `local/off` \||\| `shadow` \||receipt-backed/enforce-capable future path|What it can prove|What it cannot prove' Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md
evidence.note: Document has an explicit authority/local mode matrix separating local/off, shadow, and future receipt-backed authority modes, including what each mode can and cannot prove.

entries.desc: Confirm the matrix stays precise when it mentions transport acceptance, local PASS, or shadow diagnostics: those phrases may appear only as non-authority evidence and must not be collapsed into production authority or productionDone.

evidence.command: rg -n "accepted: true != receiptVerified|local PASS does not imply productionDone|thin-client-transport-accepted|productionDone=false|receiptVerified=false|authorityChanged=false" Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md
evidence.note: Transport acceptance, local PASS, and shadow diagnostics are documented only as non-authority evidence and cannot imply productionDone or receipt verification.

entries.desc: Grep the docs for any claim that this story implements runtime/gate/receipt verification or adds enforcement code, and verify none exists; the change must remain documentation-only and fail closed on production authority claims.

evidence.command: rg -n "not a claim that the runtime has already implemented|not a runtime scheduler|does not implement|does not verify receipts|receipt-backed enforcement|future implementation" Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md
evidence.note: The document remains documentation-only and does not claim runtime gate, receipt verification, or receipt-backed enforcement implementation.

entries.desc: Read the report/readiness/DONE/anti-pattern sections and confirm they all use the same authority boundary vocabulary: authorityMode, evidenceClass, receiptVerified, productionDone, and authorityChanged are described consistently and do not contradict the mode matrix.

evidence.note: The report, readiness, DONE, and anti-pattern sections consistently use authorityMode, evidenceClass, receiptVerified, productionDone, authorityChanged, and authorityReceiptRefs without contradicting the mode matrix.

entries.desc: Confirm the docs can mention final-report.json, readiness checklist, and DONE criteria as a coherent future-facing contract while still making clear that local CLI PASS or transport acceptance is not sufficient evidence of production authority.

evidence.command: rg -n "accepted: true != receiptVerified|local PASS does not imply productionDone|final-report.json|Readiness Checklist|DONE Criteria|local/off|shadow" Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md
evidence.note: The document treats final-report/readiness/DONE as a future-facing contract while saying local CLI PASS or transport acceptance is not production authority.

entries.desc: Verify that no report/readiness/DONE/anti-pattern statement implies the runtime already emits or enforces authority fields, and that none of them allow shadow/local evidence to satisfy production authority or DONE by implication.

evidence.command: rg -n "Any attempt to set `receiptVerified=true`, `productionDone=true`, or|Local CLI REVIEW/TEST/DONE described as production authority|Transport `accepted: true` described as receipt verification|Shadow diagnostics setting `receiptVerified=true`|not a claim that the runtime has already implemented" Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md
evidence.note: The document blocks local/shadow evidence from satisfying production authority or DONE, and does not imply runtime authority field enforcement already exists.
